text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Tama, I think that should do it
for today's vocal lessons.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that harmony sounded real good!
So, City, how'd it go? What about the
message?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"They're gathering smoothly.
Far more than I had anticipated, in fact."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Still as charming as ever, Oguri.
Your popularity is just like when I
returned to Japan... No, maybe even
greater.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius, come to think of it, when you got
back from overseas...
Oguri was still in the autumn of her
Classic year, wasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Mainichi Okan... the trial race
for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
That was the first time I ever ran against
Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, swinging all the way around the
outside to take the lead in one shot!
Nice effort, but you've gotta be out of
stamina by now, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is the end of the line, Oguri Cap!
UraaaaAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What?! A second wind?!
Don't tell me this one's... on par with
Europe's heavy hitters!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my jet lag completely
vanished.
Seems Japan's finally got someone halfway
decent.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, blew you away, didn't it?
And Oguri, that was right before our
autumn Gâ  triple crown campaign, wasn't
it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Every single one was unforgettable—truly
three blood-boiling races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Race 1: "Tenno Sho (Autumn)."
The final straight.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No way... She's not closing from behind,
she's pressing right behind the leader in
second?!
Still—I will catch her!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So you've caught up, Oguri! But I ain't
lettin' you pass.
I won't let ya!! Ngggh...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... won't move anymore! And this
pressure.
Even so... Even so, I—!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be number one in Japan!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO-RAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm on the smaller side, I can't
scrap it out at the front. That's why I've
always won from the back, unleashing a
burst of speed in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you chose to run from the front
back then. With me right behind ya,
being the one chased—your running clearly
changed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"From a 'defensive' late spurt meant to
cover up weaknesses, to an 'offensive'
late spurt unleashed entirely by your own
will."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in that moment, I too felt as though
thunder had roared right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I experienced an unprecedented shock.
Witnessing an Umamusume of the strongest
caliber fired me up once again.
However, in the upcoming Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"HELL YEAAAAAH! How's that, Oguri!?
That makes it my winning streeeeeak!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, 2nd place!? How the heck!?
I got beaten... by someone from the world
stage...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the one who won was... the American
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"She was... strong.
I suppose you never truly know someone's
hidden depth until you race them."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, American turf is closer to Japan's,
so they say you gotta be even more careful
not to overpace compared to Europe. Well,
either way, I'm just glad the two of us
get to take on the world together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And... finally, that "Arima Kinen"—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've caught up with ya! Let's do
this, Oguri!
I'll show ya the lightning strike I've bet
my life on!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come at me! Tama...!
I will... reach even greater heights than
that!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Daaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(Tama...!!
It's because of you that I made it this
far—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri... you're me.
You're another me. And that's why—)

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Tamamo
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose!! Hyaaaahhhhh!!
I can't lose!! Dyaaaahhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A clean sweep... wasn't meant to be, huh.
Got too cocky, got tripped up.
Classic pattern when you're on a winning
streak.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was happier than with any victory before
that.
Because I beat Tamamo Cross herself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, only you could've beaten me in top
form like that.
Man, even so... looking back on it now...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... this is bad.
Giving it everything I had, throwing every
last piece of myself into the race...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I couldn't give it up. None of it.
Not the passion, not victory, not my
dreams.
And the place where I chased them was
always—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You were there. In front of me, and behind
me.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I cross the finish line—you're
always right beside me.
Always, without fail—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that spot's reserved for us. Both of
us.
And I ain't handin' it over to anyone. Not
a soul.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The "Monster" and the "White Lightning"—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That time felt like an eternity...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how long are you two gonna keep
chatting?
You've got plenty of other things to do
besides vocal lessons, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The others are waitin' for us.
Inari, Creek, and Bamboo too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
Tama, let's hurry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's the final stretch.
Let's give it our all, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(There are only a handful of days left
until the actual race.)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(Let's make this the best event possible.
A live performance worthy of that clash
with Tama.)
